title: US 10,395,963 - Electrostatic chuck (lists hydrogen among backside cooling gases)
supports: Cooling gases 'may include hydrogen, helium, argon, nitrogen, and mixtures' - H2 as an ESC backside gas is in boilerplate prior art; no performance data (via search snippet; rt-IND WebSearch 1/4, query: hydrogen backside gas ESC helium substitute)

title: US 9,753,463 - Increasing the gas efficiency for an electrostatic chuck
supports: Cost/regulatory pressure on helium already drove makers to N2/Ar backside gases; OEMs actively engineer He substitution and gas efficiency, i.e. the OEMs own this design space (via search snippet; rt-IND WebSearch 1/4)

title: US 12,493,303 - Increasing the gas efficiency for an electrostatic chuck (continuation)
supports: Same-title patent (~2025 by number; family link inferred from title, not verified) in the ESC backside-gas-efficiency line - incumbent OEM patenting in the exact module LEAN ARRAY MODULE wants to license (via search snippet; rt-IND WebSearch 1/4)

title: US 8,988,957 - Sense amplifier soft-fail detection circuit (Apple)
supports: Closest hit for a per-read SA reliability flag: a test-time SA soft-fail detector, not a runtime flag to a controller. Search found no direct anticipation of RAW-BER's per-read SA flag (negative result, not FTO) (via search snippet; rt-IND WebSearch 2/4)

title: US 4,545,036 - Sense amplifier with time dependent sensitivity (Mostek)
supports: Time-dependent SA sensitivity is 1980s art; with Razor delayed sampling and NAND soft-bit sensing it supports an obviousness attack on a delayed-sample DRAM flag (via search snippet; rt-IND WebSearch 2/4)

title: NEO Semiconductor's PoC says 3D DRAM is good to go
supports: NEO 3D X-DRAM PoC on 3D-NAND-based process: <10 ns read/write, >1 s retention at 85 C, >1e14 endurance (company-reported); fabricated at NIAR-TSRI with NYCU; round led by Stan Shih (via search snippet; rt-IND WebSearch 3/4)

title: NEO Semiconductor Successfully Demos 3D X-DRAM PoC
supports: NEO describes a licensing/partnership model and is 'engaging' memory companies; no named licensee or signed partner found in results ~3 years after the 2023 3D X-DRAM launch (via search snippet; rt-IND WebSearch 3/4)

title: US 2007/0183191 - Stacked capacitor memory (diode as access device)
supports: Capacitor memory with a diode, not a MOS FET, as the access device: diode terminal to word line, capacitor storage node, other electrode to a plate line - 1D1C diode-accessed capacitor DRAM is prior art, narrowing DIODE-TOWER delta #1 when combined with Kepler 1T-nC stacks (via search snippet; rt-IND WebSearch 4/4)

title: US 11,903,185 - Vertical memory device (stacked cells sharing a plate line)
supports: Memory cells stacked along one direction may share one plate line - vertical stacked-cell plate-line sharing is patented by others (via search snippet; rt-IND WebSearch 4/4)
